title: 3.8.23 Lab: Adapt the Pattern to a List
description: Apply the save/load pattern to an array of records rather than a single object, and read one record's field back out. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Build a list of records
steps.instructions: Create a variable holding an array of at least two objects. Each object should describe one thing with a name and a value.

steps.title: Save the whole list
steps.instructions: Use JSON.stringify on the array and store it with localStorage.setItem under a key.

steps.title: Load it back
steps.instructions: Read the key with localStorage.getItem, then parse it back into an array using JSON.parse. An array round-trips exactly like an object.

steps.title: Prove it is a real array again
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print the restored array's length and one record's field, confirming the array and its objects came back whole.

requirements.title: Array of objects declared
requirements.description: Declares an array whose elements are objects

requirements.title: List restored with parse
requirements.description: Calls JSON.parse on the saved list
